reports.title: Evergy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results, Declares Quarterly Dividend and Raises 2026 Guidance

lines: “Given results ahead of expectations driven by strong operational performance and warmer weather, we are increasing our 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $4.35 to $4.50 per share from $4.14 to $4.34 per share.

We are also reaffirming our long-term adjusted EPS annual growth target of 6% to 8%+ through 2030 off the original 2026 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint of $4.24, with the expectation that annual EPS growth will exceed 8% beginning in 2028 and through 2030.”
The Company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) guidance range to $4.35 to $4.50 from its original guidance range of $4.14 to $4.34.

Additionally, the Company reaffirmed its long-term adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) annual growth target of 6% to 8%+ through 2030 based on the original 2026 adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) guidance midpoint of $4.24.
The Company expects annual adjusted EPS growth to exceed 8% beginning in 2028 and through 2030.
